intro: Version 0.5.14 fixes the blank StageTracks window at launch.
implementations: Song cards render directly from the StageTracks library.
The official download links now follow the current release manifest.
Audio import is available in Project options, next to New and Open.
fixes: A malformed Unicode regular expression no longer prevents the complete interface from starting.
Project and song cards remain visible when StageTracks starts.
The website no longer prioritizes outdated hard-coded installer links.
